description: An English retelling that stays close to the original folktale, following the persecuted princess who flees on a magical blue bull, survives deadly troll-woods of copper, silver, and gold, and disguises herself as the clattering kitchen girl Kari Woodsmock until a single lost gold shoe reveals her true identity.
tone: Classic folktale; dramatic, wondrous, and moral
summary: A mistreated princess escapes with a magical blue bull and later wins a prince when her hidden identity is revealed by a lost gold shoe.
